recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future work on these ValueSet profile definitions should happen in CRMI or through a new core tracker that explicitly reverses FHIR-37923/FHIR-37959.
issue_request: FHIR-30099 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core ValueSet. It requested adding a VSD-compliant ValueSet profile and transitioning CPG shareable/publishable/computable/executable ValueSet profiles to core, but the final resolution narrowed the immediate work to adding only VSD-P, with CPG profiles to continue separately.
initial_application: Commit 633035c38a681771dd842aabf6a90f9321529267 added a VSD aligned ValueSet StructureDefinition and cited FHIR-30099. Follow-up commits made the profile appear in the ValueSet core IG, matching the Jira comment that only VSD-P had been added in R5.
additional_context: FHIR-37923 later removed the VSD aligned ValueSet profile because the shareable, publishable, computable, and executable profile family existed. FHIR-37959 later resolved that the shareable/publishable/computable/executable profiles should be removed from core for R6 and maintained in CRMI with unchanged canonical URLs. Current source has an empty ValueSet core IG profile list and active pattern guidance that points implementers to CRMI.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing VSD-P or the migrated profile family into the current core source would conflict with later applied/published Vocab decisions.
